items.title: Sonny Igoe interviewed by Monk Rowe, Emerson, New Jersey, July 31, 2003
items.q: I remember our wedding night my wife and I saw two Charles Dickens movies.

ctx.x: You weren’t throwing sandwiches, were you?
No, no, nothing like that. I think we went to the local tavern. So anyway — oh I remember our wedding night my wife and I saw two Charles Dickens movies.
